is_anopheles.evidence: The study evaluated field-collected Anopheles gambiae s.s., Anopheles arabiensis, and Anopheles funestus s.s. from Western Kenya (page 2, lines 42-46; page 9, lines 218-225).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotyped Vgsc L1014S (L995S), Vgsc L1014F (L995F), Vgsc N1575Y (N1570Y), and Ace-1 G119S (G280S) using TaqMan assays (page 8, lines 191-193; page 27, Table 2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 (page 27) reports allele frequencies for Vgsc L1014S, L1014F, 1575Y, and Ace-1 G119S along with sample size (n) for indoor and outdoor populations of An. gambiae s.s. and An. arabiensis.

african_field_population.evidence: Resting adult mosquitoes were collected from household indoor units and outdoor pit/pot shelters in Kisian (Kisumu county) and Kimaeti (Bungoma county), Western Kenya in 2019 (page 5, lines 120-136).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical field study investigating insecticide resistance status, metabolic enzyme levels, and marker frequencies in wild vector populations.

sub_country_location.evidence: Specific study sites with GPS coordinates reported: Kisian (0.0749° S, 34.6663° E) in Kisumu county and Kimaeti (0.6029° N, 34.4073° E) in Bungoma county, Kenya (page 5, lines 120-122).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected during the long (May-July) and short (October-November) rainy seasons of 2019 (page 5, lines 132-133).

duplicate_risk.evidence: No evidence that these sample collections overlap with previously published primary datasets.

supplement.evidence: All primary genotype frequency data, sample sizes, and bioassay results are completely detailed in the main text and Tables 1-2.

assessment.summary: This primary study examined phenotypic insecticide resistance, synergistic effect of PBO, detoxification enzyme levels, and resistance marker frequencies (Vgsc L1014S, L1014F, N1575Y, and Ace-1 G119S) in indoor vs. outdoor resting populations of An. gambiae s.s., An. arabiensis, and An. funestus from Kisian and Kimaeti in Western Kenya in 2019.
